page.layout: One page of text. Top: a dedication title block, centred, in several type styles, ending with the greeting "S." Below: one paragraph opening with a woodcut initial at the left. At the foot: a signature mark at left-centre and a catchword at right. No margin notes, no running head, no page number.

main_text.head: Nobilissimo, Amplissimo, Consultissimoque DOMINO, D. CORNELIO à DOMBURCH, JCto. Nuper Curiæ Provincialis Senatori, & jam Reipublicæ Ultrajectinæ Consuli gravissimo
main_text.p: AQuo linguam San-ctam in Celeber-rima Vestra Aca-demia publicè doceo, an-ni elapsi sunt triginta sex, & quod excurrit. Ad ejus

page.notes: The large woodcut initial A is joined to the first word as "AQuo", following the rule for drop caps. The "S." before the body is the greeting of the dedication and is kept as a paragraph. The title lines are italic, spaced capitals, or large roman capitals; the italic lines were read as italic. "JCto." has a superscript "to" in print, written here inline. The long s in the italic title lines is written as plain s. No doubtful readings.
